intro: Navigating Chennai's bustling roads, peak-hour OMR tech corridor traffic, and congested metropolitan intersections can be exhausting. Having a dedicated, calm, and punctual personal driver transforms daily travel from a stressful chore into relaxing, productive time. Colours Life Manpower Agency helps families and professionals in Okkiyam Thoraipakkam, OMR, Perungudi, Velachery, and Chennai hire trustworthy personal and family drivers.
whoIsItFor: Corporate executives, entrepreneurs, and IT professionals commuting along OMR, GST Road, and central business districts who want to work or rest during transit.
Families needing safe, dependable morning and afternoon transportation for school and tuition pick-ups and drop-offs.
Elderly family members who do not drive and require safe transit to hospitals, temples, banks, and social visits.
Households seeking a full-time family chauffeur for daily city travel, shopping errands, and weekend outstation trips.
availableWorkers: Our drivers are polite, punctual individuals familiar with Chennai's arterial roads, bypasses, OMR IT parks, and residential layouts. They operate both manual and automatic transmission personal cars (hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs, and luxury vehicles) with careful road sense.
keyResponsibilities: Punctual morning reporting and safe daily driving for office commutes and family travel.
Safe school transportation for children, adhering strictly to speed limits and school safety guidelines.
Basic daily vehicle maintenance checks: checking engine oil levels, coolant, tire pressure, and ensuring clean interiors.
Daily vehicle dusting, washing, and wiping to maintain a clean, comfortable vehicle for the family.
Running household errands such as picking up groceries, delivering packages, and taking the vehicle for routine servicing.
Familiarity with GPS navigation tools (Google Maps) to choose efficient, traffic-free routes across Chennai.
localCoverage: We serve Okkiyam Thoraipakkam, OMR, Perungudi, Sholinganallur, Karapakkam, Velachery, Adyar, Semmancheri, Navalur, Siruseri, Pallavaram, Guindy, and all of Chennai.
disclaimer: Drivers operate the client's privately owned vehicles. Vehicle insurance, fuel, toll charges, and vehicle roadworthiness remain the legal responsibility of the vehicle owner.

faqs.question: Can I hire a monthly personal driver in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Yes, we specialize in monthly full-time personal and family drivers (typically 8 to 10-hour daily shifts, 6 days a week).

faqs.question: Can the driver handle automatic luxury cars and SUVs?
faqs.answer: Yes, our drivers are experienced with both manual and automatic transmissions across various car brands and vehicle sizes.

faqs.question: Does the driver also wash the car?
faqs.answer: Yes, daily exterior dusting and cleaning, as well as interior tidying, are standard parts of the driver's responsibilities.

faqs.question: What documents do you verify for drivers?
faqs.answer: We verify the driver's driving license (LMV), government identity proof (Aadhaar card), and residential background references.

faqs.question: Can the driver go on occasional outstation trips outside Chennai?
faqs.answer: Yes, with prior agreement and suitable travel/food allowances, drivers can accompany families on outstation trips across Tamil Nadu.
